head: SANS
dzh: 米色原木、低饱和、小字大留白
den: Oat and wood tones, muted, small type and lots of space
nzh: 像杂货家居品牌：字偏小偏细、留白很多；只用米、原木棕、灰绿，饱和度低；照片柔光、木麻陶这类自然材质；细线分隔几乎不用阴影，主按钮深棕实底
nen: Like a homeware brand: small light type and lots of space; only oat, wood brown and sage, low saturation; soft-light photos of wood, linen and ceramic; hairlines, almost no shadow, solid dark-brown main button
